title: NEWS: Every 007 watch Omega released in 2026, just before a new Bond was named
hook: Omega dropped three Bond watches this year. Then 007 changed.
why: Third Bond post: what you can actually buy. FACTS (Omega's own US site for prices): (1) Seamaster Diver 300M Chronograph 007 First Light, made for the 007 First Light video game (released 27 May 2026), first chronograph in Bond's Seamaster line, 44 mm steel, US$9,400 (Monochrome: https://monochrome-watches.com/omega-seamaster-diver-300m-chronograph-007-first-light-from-video-game-to-reality-review-price/ ; Fratello: https://www.fratellowatches.com/omega-introduces-the-seamaster-diver-300m-chronograph-007-first-light/). (2) Seamaster Diver 300M James Bond Edition 210.30.42.20.03.004, blue, US$8,600, and (3) Spectre Edition 210.30.42.20.01.023, black, US$8,600, both launched 5 Oct 2026 (Global James Bond Day), non-limited; plus limited sets of 77 at US$89,800 (Monochrome: https://monochrome-watches.com/omega-seamaster-diver-300m-james-bond-and-spectre-collection-2026-review-price/ ; Omega catalogue: https://www.omegawatches.com/en-us/watches/seamaster/diver-300-m/007-edition/catalog). Re-check each price on omegawatches.com before use (Fratello quotes $8,700 for the Oct pair). Context: Amazon MGM named Robert Pattinson the new Bond on 16 Nov 2026 (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/james-bond-robert-pattinson-cast-amazon-mgm-film); his film watch is not confirmed. End with a vote: 'Which one would you wear: First Light, Bond or Spectre?' then follow.
